## Change

Describe the visible change and its purpose.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run verify`
- [ ] `npm run test:integration` for content/build changes
- [ ] Desktop/mobile interactions checked, or verification limit stated
- [ ] No secrets, invented claims or accidental publication of drafts
- [ ] Published URLs kept stable, or redirects included

## Deployment

Merging into `main` publishes after checks, when repository FTPS secrets are configured.
